mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-9d091b54.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Find each rectangular frame, and fill its interior with the pattern
    # represented by isolated marker pixels of the frame's other associated color.
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # frames are solid rectangular borders of a color, dimensions >= 4
    for color in range(1,10):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==color]
        # identify exact rectangle borders from extrema; skip noise disconnected
        unseen=set(cells)
        while unseen:
            seed=unseen.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if p in unseen: unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); stack.append(p)
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]; r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0<3 or c1-c0<3: continue
            border={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)}
            if not border.issubset(comp): continue
            # associated markers: isolated pixels in the interior, not frame color.
            interior=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
            colors={grid[r][c] for r,c in interior if grid[r][c] not in (0,color)}
            if len(colors)!=1: continue
            mark=next(iter(colors))
            pts=[(r,c) for r,c in interior if grid[r][c]==mark]
            if len(pts)!=1: continue
            # Pattern is alternating checker placement, seeded by marker location;
            # expand to full interior checkerboard. Marker indicates pattern color.
            pr,pc=pts[0]
            for r,c in interior:
                if (r+c-pr-pc)%2==0: out[r][c]=mark
                else: out[r][c]=0
    return out
PY
